newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-UHIS TO LAUNCH NEW OPEN-END FUNDS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-UHIS TO LAUNCH NEW OPEN-END FUNDS.

text.p: Uhispank, Estonia's second largest bank, plans to launch several open-end funds in the autumn, including the Baltic Index Fund covering the key stocks from every Baltic country.
Uhispank hopes to launch the Baltic Index Fund and the capital markets fund in September plus a Russian index fund in the autumn, the bank's capital markets head Margus Kangro told Reuters.
"The (Baltic Index) fund is for a foreign investor to whom it is difficult to choose between shares," Kangro said.
The fund will cover 30 stocks or ten from every three Baltic country.
Uhispank will manage the fund with business newspaper Aripaev, which has already launched its Baltic Index which covers the ten leading stocks from each of the three Baltic stock markets.
Uhispank wants to launch the Russian index fund together with a Russian partner, Kangro added.
